description: This file is a comprehensive markdown documentation describing the Motion Sensor HAL interface implementation, capabilities, use cases, lifecycle, and configuration details for RDK devices. It includes sections on supported sensor types, API requirements, interface definitions, state machine, time windows scheduling, and example scenarios, but contains no executable code or language-specific code snippets beyond illustrative aidl parcelables.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Immutable sensor capabilities including name, sensitivity range, and deep sleep autonomy support.

classes.name: TimeWindow
classes.description: Defines a daily active period for motion sensing scheduling, with start and end times in seconds since midnight.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns an immutable Capabilities parcel describing sensor properties.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Activates motion detection with specified mode, inactivity window, and timing parameters.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Deactivates motion detection and disarms sensors.

methods.name: setActiveWindows
methods.description: Configures scheduled active periods for the sensor, affecting event delivery timing.
